name: H20 B — Public catalogue and proposal generator

parameters.content: Firebase ID tokens are verified through accounts:lookup for this Firebase project before protected data access. Staff must have the server-managed custom claim staff:true. Select your Data Table and Gemini credentials, then publish. No shared staff password is used.

parameters.jsCode: const result=$('Result').first().json;const saved=$input.all();if(saved.some(item=>item.json.error))return [{json:{status:503,response:{error:'Opslaan mislukt. Probeer opnieuw met dezelfde aanvraagreferentie.'}}}];return [{json:{status:result.status,response:result.response}}];
